State the outcome. Let Solvers compete. Instead of choosing a bridge and route, you declare what you want — the asset, price, and chain. Solvers compete to fulfill your intent at the best rate. A verifier contract on NEAR checks the fill and settles it on-chain. Rhea builds on top of NEAR Intents, aggregating solver quotes to access deep liquidity across supported networks. 01 State Declare the outcome — the asset, the price, and the chain.
